title: Addressing the Stakeholder
description: How to write for a reader acting as Stakeholder. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `stakeholder` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Self-contained at every checkpoint
rules.description: Self-contained at every checkpoint. Restate what is being asked and why it matters; never assume the last conversation is remembered.

source.quote: Affected by the outcome, not building it. Reviews at defined checkpoints and otherwise is not watching. Needs to re-acquire context each time without reading the history.
